name: Vincent Noble
original_name: ヴィンセント＝ノーブル
source:
A youth from a good family who's a student at a prestigious school.
He's recieving personal tutoring from Cezary and often comes around to the mansion.
He's a bit standoffish towards the protagonist who doesn't know anything about him.
